narration: Tonight Ishaan needs a ceiling-sized crocodile, or nobody sleeps. His sister is already waiting.
caption: आज रात इशान को छत भर का मगरमच्छ चाहिए, वरना कोई नहीं सोएगा।
image_brief: Ishaan, a seven-year-old boy in striped pyjamas with short black hair and a chipped front tooth, kneeling on a low wooden cot in a small bedroom at night, one hand raised toward the plain ceiling, a small metal torch glowing on a stool beside him.

narration: Ishaan lifts both hands beside the small torch. A shadow lands on the wall.
caption: इशान ने छोटी टॉर्च के पास दोनों हाथ उठाए। दीवार पर एक परछाई बनी।
image_brief: Only Ishaan's two raised hands and the lit torch on the stool, warm light spilling past his fingers onto the bedroom wall.

narration: It is slipper-sized. Ishaan wants the whole ceiling.
caption: परछाई चप्पल जितनी है। इशान को पूरी छत चाहिए।
image_brief: The bedroom wall with a small crocodile-shaped shadow no bigger than a slipper, and a real slipper lying on the floorboards below it.

narration: Every night Ishaan's sister asks for the crocodile. Every night it stays small.
caption: हर रात इशान की बहन मगरमच्छ माँगती है। हर रात परछाई छोटी ही रहती है।
image_brief: Ishaan's little sister, a four-year-old in a blue nightdress with two short braids, sitting up in the next cot with her blanket at her chin, facing the dim wall.

narration: Ishaan bends three fingers into a long snout. He snaps them shut.
caption: इशान ने तीन उँगलियाँ मोड़कर लंबी नाक बनाई। फिर उन्हें झटके से बंद किया।
image_brief: Ishaan's hand held sideways with three fingers curled into a snout shape, the bright torch bulb just behind his knuckles.

narration: Ishaan whispers it into the dark. One snap, two snap, crocodile!
caption: इशान अँधेरे में धीरे से बोला। एक चटक, दो चटक, मगरमच्छ!
image_brief: Ishaan whispering with his mouth close to his own shadowed hands, torch light edging his cheek, the rest of the room dark.

narration: The wall crocodile snaps back, slipper-sized. The ceiling stays empty.
caption: दीवार का मगरमच्छ चप्पल जितना ही चटका। छत ख़ाली रही।
image_brief: The bedroom ceiling, flat and unlit, with the torch glow stopping at the very top of the wall below it.

narration: Ishaan wants it up there instead. Big enough to swim over both cots.
caption: इशान को वह ऊपर छत पर चाहिए। इतना बड़ा कि दोनों खाटों के ऊपर तैर सके।
image_brief: The two low cots side by side seen from the bedroom doorway, both children small in them, the wide empty ceiling above.

narration: Ishaan's sister can already do a rabbit. Two fingers, two ears.
caption: इशान की बहन को खरगोश बनाना आता है। दो उँगलियाँ, दो कान।
image_brief: The little sister's hand making a rabbit with two raised fingers, its shadow falling on the wall next to Ishaan's hands.

narration: Rabbits are easy. A crocodile needs a whole ceiling.
caption: खरगोश बनाना आसान है। मगरमच्छ को पूरी छत चाहिए।
image_brief: A neat rabbit shadow and a much smaller crocodile shadow side by side on the bedroom wall, low torch light behind them.

narration: Ishaan has planned this for four nights. Tonight he finishes it.
caption: इशान चार रातों से यही सोच रहा था। आज रात वह इसे पूरा करेगा।
image_brief: Ishaan sitting cross-legged on his cot with four pencil drawings of crocodiles on torn notebook paper spread in front of him, lit by the torch.

narration: The torch stands on a wooden stool. Its light makes a wide yellow circle.
caption: टॉर्च लकड़ी के स्टूल पर खड़ी है। उसकी रोशनी चौड़ा पीला गोला बनाती है।
image_brief: The torch standing upright on the wooden stool, its wide yellow circle of light printed on the bedroom wall.

narration: Ishaan kneels on his cot and reaches up. The ceiling stays far away.
caption: इशान खाट पर घुटनों के बल हाथ ऊपर करता है। छत दूर ही रहती है।
image_brief: Ishaan stretched upward on his knees on the cot, fingertips still far below the ceiling, torch light on his back.

narration: So Ishaan straightens both arms above his head. The shadow climbs the wall.
caption: तो इशान ने दोनों हाथ सिर के ऊपर सीधे कर दिए। परछाई दीवार पर चढ़ने लगी।
image_brief: Ishaan standing on his cot with both arms straight above his head, a long crocodile shadow climbing the wall behind him.

narration: At the top it bends. Ishaan's crocodile folds in half.
caption: ऊपर पहुँचकर परछाई मुड़ जाती है। इशान का मगरमच्छ आधा मुड़ जाता है।
image_brief: The crocodile shadow bending sharply where the wall meets the ceiling, its head squashed flat along the corner.
